name: Alignment of Priorities
purpose: A visual aid to align priorities of key stakeholders.
whereUsed: The Alignment of Priorities is best used in the Problem Space during the Awareness Phase (1.1) to “Gain Business Clarity”. It’s also useful in the Solution Space to confirm alignment.
why: We will accelerate agreement by illustrating how initiatives and solutions contribute to the goals of the business and the top of mind priorities for key stakeholders.
outcomes: Confirm that organizational alignment is of importance to stakeholders
Initial “draft” of the priorities for stakeholders across the organization
Clarification of business goals and strategies
Executive clarity as to how solutions address top of mind business initiatives

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “PROBLEM SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Review structure and use of colors within visual
Review and refine what is known for each of the columns
Understand the relationships within and across columns
Challenge the relevance of initiatives or solutions under consideration
Document any ambiguity that creates gaps to success

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “SOLUTION SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Confirm how an initiative or solution aligns to the business priorities of key stakeholders
Test the importance of an initiative or solution based on the business priorities
